text:
Anya: Quick ask — we need a tight sell-sheet (1-pager PDF + web microcopy) for enterprise buyers. Focus: deploy modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), security + compliance blurbs, SLA bullet, and a short benchmark callout. Launch target: Monday AM. Design + product + sales review before Fri EOD.

Mike: Got it. I can pull p50 latency and cost delta for hosted vs dedicated. Also recommend a tiny TOC: Top exec value, 3 deploy boxes, benchmark callout, customer outcome, CTA.

Jun: Suggest a technical callout about batching/quantization benefits — one line like: 'Optimized batching + quantization reduces per-token cost by ~3x without measurable quality drop.'

Sara: I'll do layout. Question on tone — keep it light (sales) or rigorous (benchmarks)?

Anya: Hybrid — headline should be product-forward and simple, then a 3-bullet technical strip for engineers.

Trent: For inbound routing, recommend this microflow on the sheet: 'Enterprise lead -> Sales Assist -> Demo scheduled within 24 hrs -> Dedicated onboarding conversation'. Make sure there's a clear checkbox CTA: 'Schedule enterprise briefing'.

Emma: Legal flag — add a short compliance line: 'Supports SOC 2 Type II, optional HIPAA BAA, customer-managed KMS for Private.' Avoid absolute uptime claims.

Jun: Also add a short fallback note: 'Automatic model fallback to compatible variants ensures graceful degradation under peak load.'

Mike: Draft benchmark numbers (needs final infra confirmation): Hosted p50 gen latency (short prompt) = 120ms; Dedicated p50 = 45ms; Throughput example: Dedicated pool 8k tokens/min under baseline load. Cost delta example line: Hosted list-price ~ $0.07 / 1k tokens vs Dedicated reserved ~$0.03 / 1k tokens at committed levels. Use 'example' language.

Sara: Perfect — I'll mock two versions: one with a compact chart (latency vs cost) and a second simplified icon strip for execs. Will send PDF mock by Thu EOD.

Anya: Webinar tie-in: we'll run a 30-min launch webinar Tue afternoon (post-launch) — agenda: why deploy modes matter, benchmark walk-through, customer story + Q&A. Mike + Jun to own tech demo, Trent to join for GTM.

Trent: I'll write the 2-sentence customer vignette for the sell-sheet: 'A fintech used Dedicated to meet SLAs and cut per-call inference costs by ~40% while keeping inference on approved cloud regions.'

Emma: Also add a short 'security controls' bullet list: VPC peering, private endpoints, KMS/HSM options, audit logs retention (configurable).

Jun: Routing snippet we can include as an inline block for sales ops: 
```
if lead.type == "enterprise": route -> sales-assist
else: route -> self-serve
```

Anya: Love it. Final asks: (1) Sara mock by Thu EOD, (2) Mike confirm infra numbers by Fri morning, (3) Trent provide CTA copy + inbound routing snippet by Thu. I'll consolidate and book a 30-min review Fri 10am PT.

LaunchBot: Post draft scheduled for Monday 09:00 PT. Reminder set for design review Thu 10:00 AM.

Mike: On it — I'll chase infra today.

Sara: Will share initial PDF mock in #marketing-files when ready. :paintbrush:

Trent: CTA copy draft: 'Request enterprise briefing' + small note 'Or schedule a hands-on demo'.

Anya: Thanks team — goal is concise, trust-forward, technically credible. Quick thumbs if you're aligned. :thumbsup:
